timeline.summary: Huatli and Inti return to Pachatupa with a captured Legion of Dusk sword after a final victory on the Sun Coast.
timeline.quote: Huatli and Inti were returning from the Sun Empire's last major campaign on the Sun Coast.

citation.work: A Question of Confidence
citation.text: "A Question of Confidence" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: A month later Huatli and Inti ride to a Brazen Coalition camp on the coast and burn its supplies.
timeline.quote: Sparks flew onto the dry wood of the crates, and almost instantly they caught flame.

citation.work: A Question of Confidence
citation.text: "A Question of Confidence" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli fights Angrath and wounds him, but he overpowers her and Inti with his searing chains.
timeline.quote: she sliced a clean line across his chest with her blade.

citation.work: A Question of Confidence
citation.text: "A Question of Confidence" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Angrath recognizes Huatli as another planeswalker and offers to help each other leave, but she wounds him and flees with Inti.
timeline.quote: You're one too!

citation.work: A Question of Confidence
citation.text: "A Question of Confidence" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli tells Inti she believes she saw Orazca.
timeline.quote: I think I saw Orazca.

citation.work: A Question of Confidence
citation.text: "A Question of Confidence" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Inti offers to accompany Huatli with Teyeuh, and Huatli admits she wants to find the city.
timeline.quote: I want to find the city.

citation.work: A Question of Confidence
citation.text: "A Question of Confidence" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli and her riders search the beach for a River Herald who could guide her to the Golden City.
timeline.quote: This is where she would find her guide to lead her to the Golden City.

citation.work: The Race, Part 1
citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli finds the unconscious Tishana on a rock and wakes her.
timeline.quote: There, lying on the rock overlooking the vast, unending ocean, was an unconscious female merfolk.

citation.work: The Race, Part 1
citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli sends Inti and Teyeuh after a fleeing vampire.
timeline.quote: Inti, tail them!

citation.work: The Race, Part 1
citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: As an eight-year-old, Huatli asks a priest what is on the far side of the sun and is told it doesn't matter (flashback).
timeline.quote: What's on the far side of the sun?

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli's family embraces her on her return.
timeline.quote: They all tackled Huatli in an embrace

citation.work: Who Tells the Stories
citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli demonstrates planeswalking to her family, who are ecstatic.
timeline.quote: when she demonstrated by vanishing and reappearing a moment later with a rock from another world in her hand, they were ecstatic.

citation.work: Who Tells the Stories
citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Inti convinces Huatli her destiny does not lie in Pachatupa.
timeline.quote: Your destiny does not lie here.

citation.work: Who Tells the Stories
citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli's family steals the helm of the warrior-poet for her.
timeline.quote: with Inti wearing the helm on his head and a foolhardy smile on his face.

citation.work: Who Tells the Stories
citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Inti tells Huatli her duty is to gather stories from beyond the empire.
timeline.quote: You are the warrior-poet. It is your duty to gather stories.

citation.work: Who Tells the Stories
citation.text: "Who Tells the Stories" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Feb 2018.

timeline.summary: Hours before, Huatli's company and the auxiliaries shelter in a barricaded hall, and Inti urges them to go.
timeline.quote: I'm not confident the barricade or this hall will hold.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Commanders report the collapse of the empire's defenses as Phyrexians ring Pachatupa.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: At Orazca, scouts report a route to the temple and Temilo, a garrisoned soldier, joins them.
timeline.quote: We have a route to the temple.

citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.
